schema:name: Coffee Cupping, Hacienda La Minita
schema:description:
This image depicts a coffee cupping arrangement, a process used to test coffee beans for prominent flavors and aromas. The coffee is brewed in a precise way that limits variations between cups, and tasters use a wide spoon to sample each cup.

Hacienda La Minita serves as Distant Lands Coffee’s green coffee trading division, sourcing specialty coffee from countries such as Ethiopia. Coffee in Ethiopia is grown largely by smallholder farmers and processed at local cooperatives and washing stations. Ethiopian coffees may be wet or dry processed, depending in part on the miller’s intended process and the availability of water.
